condition.breakout: latest close reaches recent 21-trading-day closing high
condition.earlyWatch: 21-day volume >= 1.2x, 5-day volume >= 1.8x, MFI >= 85, and 21-day return >= 30% or 21-day high breakout
condition.observation: 21-day return >= 50%, relative return >= 30%p, MFI >= 70, near 21-day high, 21-day volume >= 1x, and 5-day volume >= 0.9x

note: Forward returns are included only for historical review and are not used in the screen.
universe: KRX listed corporations from KIND; KOSPI/KOSDAQ stocks only
